name: RegBench
description: Source-grounded benchmark for regulatory cross-reference reasoning. Given a scenario, a model must follow explicit cross-references through a regulatory corpus, apply the resulting chain, and produce an answer that contains every required atomic fact. Items are scored by strict atomic-fact conjunction. Built over DNV Ship Rules (maritime classification) and Basel III §217 (US banking).
citeAs: @inproceedings{regbench2026, title={RegBench: Source-Grounded Benchmarks for Regulatory Cross-Reference Reasoning}, author={Anonymous}, booktitle={NeurIPS 2026 Datasets and Benchmarks Track}, year={2026}}
rai:dataCollection: Items are LLM-synthesised (Claude Sonnet 4.6 at temperature 0.3) over chains sampled from the cross-reference graphs of two public regulatory corpora: DNV Ship Rules and 12 CFR Part 217 (Basel III). Section identifiers and verbatim source spans are preserved in each item's annotator_grounding field. No human-subject data is collected; no PII; scenarios involve hypothetical ship designs and bank capital positions.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Two-stage annotation. Stage 1 (automated): a calibrated v5d audit (locked GPT-5.4 prompt at xhigh reasoning effort) decomposes each item into per-fact reads against verbatim source and assigns an item-level disposition. Stage 2 (human): every v5d-flagged item is source-grounded re-reviewed by credentialed reviewers (three DNV ship-design SMEs for DNV; four finance-credentialed reviewers for Basel) under a v5d-advisory protocol. Reviewers see v5d's item-level disposition as an advisory hint on flagged items; v5d's per-fact reasoning is rendered only on flagged items, so per-fact judgements on v5d-passed items are independent of audit flagging at the fact level. Raw SME annotation labels and disagreement logs are retained internally to preserve audit-slate integrity.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: On the held-out DNV TEST split: 0/446 fact-level miss rate on v5d-passed items (rule-of-three 95% upper bound ≤ 0.67%); 98.94% fact-level agreement with SME source-grounded re-review. On the combined 200-item DNV TRAIN+TEST audit pool: 99.0% item-level agreement, 99.1% fact-level agreement, 97.4% recall, 100% precision on SME-flagged items. Locked v5d ports unchanged to Basel III §217: 76/79 item / 453/478 fact agreement on the audited slice; 0/122 fact-level defects on the 20-item v5d-pass sample. Inter-annotator agreement on DNV TEST overlap: κ = 0.77 item / 0.905 fact.
rai:dataLimitations: Two corpora (marine engineering + US banking); transfer to FDA/FAA/non-English regimes is not demonstrated. 827 questions / 4,766 atomic facts is modest in scale; we traded scale for verified quality. Tier (chain-depth) definitions are within-domain; cross-domain claims concern pattern, not absolute level. Closed-book performance is 0–4% across the evaluated panel — item-level memorisation is precluded by construction (scenarios are LLM-synthesised after corpus snapshots), but subtler latent contamination cannot be fully ruled out.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended to enable evaluation of LLMs and retrieval systems on source-grounded multi-hop regulatory reasoning, and to surface the chain-incorrect / conclusion-correct failure mode that lenient scoring hides. Not intended for: training compliance-decision systems, certifying any model for production regulatory use, or making broad regulatory-reasoning competence claims beyond explicit cross-reference traversal.
rai:dataBiases: English-only corpora. Two regulatory regimes (US/international banking; international maritime classification under DNV). Tier-coverage is balanced within each corpus by construction (10 items per tier in the pilot subset; ~100 items per tier in the DNV main split). Question-form distribution: mix of MCQ and free-form explanation items.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. Source corpora are public regulatory text; scenarios are hypothetical and contain no personal, sensitive, or proprietary information. No human-subject data was collected.

recordSet.name: regbench-items
recordSet.description: RegBench item record set: scenario-anchored, chain-grounded QA items with strict atomic-fact propositions.

field.name: source_section
field.description: Anchor section identifier where reasoning starts.

field.name: question_text
field.description: Scenario-style question, self-contained; chain identifiers are not leaked into the prompt.

field.name: correct
field.description: MCQ correct option key (when format == mcq).

field.name: required_facts
field.description: Atomic propositions the answer must contain. Strict-conjunction graded.

field.name: annotator_grounding
field.description: Source-grounded rationale (chain identifiers, target section quotes, derivation steps).

field.name: scenario_parameters
field.description: Numeric / categorical inputs that define the scenario.

recordSet.description: Per-item v5d audit dispositions over the audited subset of the released pool. See data/v5d_verdicts.README.md for coverage.
